description: Production cases that must pass against the candidate deployment (phase-7.md, Production evidence, step 12). Each case writes one <case>.json report into .local/evidence/production/<deployment id>/ with {case, status, deploymentId, deploymentUrl, commit, recordedAt, runId}; a case of kind partner also records exitCode from check_partner.mjs, and a case of kind binding records deploymentCommit, aliasCommit and identity: {source, before, after}, where before and after are {checkedAt, deployments: {<host>: <deployment id>}} from Vercel's alias inspection of the deployment URL host and every host in the case's aliases, taken before the first and after the last other case. run.json in the same directory holds the runId of the evidence run. The analyzer rejects a case that is missing, not passed, bound to another deployment, commit or run, recorded before the deployment was created, or recorded outside the binding case's identity checks; and a binding case whose identity names another deployment, or none, for any of those hosts.
